propositions: Mutation gate hard-fails with exit code 2 when executed against a patchset based on a commit older than the one introducing scripts/mutation_gate.py, because the script is absent from the checked-out tree.

Sibling gates (env-var registry, comment hygiene) already implement a guard that skips cleanly with an explanatory message when their respective scripts are absent, but the mutation gate lacks this guard.
The mutation gate must skip with exit 0 and an explanatory message when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, matching sibling gate behavior.
Changes based before the walking-skeleton commit should not receive Verified -1 from the mutation gate.
Changes based at or after the walking-skeleton commit must still execute the gate normally and not be silently bypassed by the absence guard.
